page.summary: Carry a flashlight and pre-position for a clear pickup blind; abandon the save when the Killer denies the angle or the pickup window passes.

verdict.recommendation: Shadow only a nearby chase with a plausible pickup and exit; do not turn every chase into lost generator time.
verdict.soloQ: Use a save you can read from your own position; avoid long speculative travel after a down.
verdict.coordinatedSwf: Call who is covering the pickup so one saver approaches while others maintain objectives.
verdict.mainWeakness: Walls, changed facing, delayed pickups and slugging can deny the blind while the saver spends time and flashlight charges.

options.whyItsHere: A pickup of another Survivor opens a 10-second run-start window for a 50% Haste burst lasting 5 seconds if not Exhausted; it helps reach an angle but does not supply the flashlight or guarantee a blind.

item.name: Flashlight
item.why: The carried item supplies the line-of-sight blind; without it this specific save method is unavailable.

opening: Check flashlight charges, a reachable sightline and an exit before leaving repair to follow a chase.

rows.situation: A nearby chase may end where you can see the Killer's pickup position.
rows.action: Stay out of the Killer's immediate path and move to a usable blind angle without exposing yourself or abandoning a distant objective.
rows.why: Pickup timing cannot compensate for a blocked sightline or a saver who arrives too late.

rows.situation: The Killer begins picking up another Survivor and you are not Exhausted.
rows.action: Start running inside the perk's 10-second activation window only if its burst can reach a real flashlight angle.
rows.why: Background Player moves the saver; it neither blinds the Killer nor creates a valid angle.

rows.situation: You have a charged flashlight, a clear line of sight and the Killer has committed to a pickup or carry window.
rows.action: Time the beam for the actual save window and leave space for the freed teammate to escape. If the Killer faces a wall or changes facing, do not spend charges at the old angle.
rows.why: The payoff is preventing a hook, not merely shining the item.

rows.situation: The Killer delays pickup, leaves the teammate down, blocks the sightline or the save window has passed.
rows.action: Break off and return to repair or plan the hook/recovery response instead of hovering for a second forced blind.
rows.why: Continued shadowing costs team tempo while the Killer controls the interaction.

abortWhen: No flashlight charges or reachable sightline remain.
The Killer denies or completes the pickup before you can attempt a meaningful blind.

weaknesses: Requires a carried flashlight, charges, line of sight and precise positioning; the Killer can face cover or refuse the pickup.
commonMistakes: Following a chase across the map for a save with no viable angle.
Using the movement burst as if it guarantees a flashlight blind.
